discrepancy_explanation.why_two_tables_differ: The two ablation tables represent fundamentally different experimental protocols: (1) audit_controller_ablation.py tested a forward cumulative integration of bug fixes starting from buggy ULC-v1; (2) ulc_audit.py tested a backward leave-one-out ablation starting from full ULC-v3. (3) The table in FINAL_RESEARCH_VERDICT.md represented diagnostic measurements from Phase 8-11 ULC_DIAGNOSTICS.md, not the audit's own Python ablation runner.
discrepancy_explanation.why_leave_one_out_had_identical_values: In ulc_ablation_results.csv, rows 0, 1, 2, 3, and 5 had identical accuracy (83.27%) and recall (13.47%). This occurred because the synthetic stream generator parameters in that specific script did not produce an error rate exceeding the ADWIN threshold. Because false_resets was 0.0, the code path inside controller.step() that executes directive.purge_replay, clf.reset(), and opt.state.clear() was never triggered! Thus, disabling those handlers produced zero empirical effect. Only disabling the ensemble (which operates on every batch) produced a measurable change.

1_loss_trend_tracking.mechanism: Calculates exponential moving average slope of batch loss to distinguish noise spikes from true drift.
1_loss_trend_tracking.operational_impact: Prevents spurious warning state triggers during transient single-batch noise.

2_deadband_hysteresis.mechanism: Requires 3 consecutive warning steps before confirming drift transition.
2_deadband_hysteresis.operational_impact: Completely eliminates false drift resets during 10-batch noise burst (false resets drop from 10.0 to 1.0).

3_probability_ensemble.mechanism: Blends Hoeffding tree class probabilities with linear surrogate probabilities: 0.50 * p_tree + 0.50 * p_lin.
3_probability_ensemble.isolated_delta_macro_f1: +0.0493 (in cumulative ablation, Macro F1 jumps from 0.4737 to 0.5230)
3_probability_ensemble.operational_impact: Sole architectural component that recovers non-zero minority recall (0.0% to 13.47% at default threshold) during post-drift starvation.

4_replay_buffer_purge.mechanism: Clears class-balanced reservoir buffer upon confirmed concept drift.
4_replay_buffer_purge.isolated_delta_macro_f1: +0.0000 in isolation (Stage 1 to 2); +0.0003 when combined with tree resets.
4_replay_buffer_purge.operational_impact: Prevents stale pre-drift minority samples from polluting post-drift tree growth; ineffective if tree is not reset.

5_tree_adaptation_reset.mechanism: Re-initializes Hoeffding tree root upon confirmed drift directive.
5_tree_adaptation_reset.isolated_delta_macro_f1: +0.0000 in isolation (Stage 2 to 3); essential prerequisite for post-drift learning.
5_tree_adaptation_reset.operational_impact: Purges obsolete split statistics; requires aligned surrogate to maintain accuracy during tree re-growth.

6_optimizer_state_reset.mechanism: Flushes LowMemoryAdamW first/second moments (opt.state.clear()) upon confirmed drift.
6_optimizer_state_reset.isolated_delta_macro_f1: +0.0371 (Stage 3 to Stage 4 Macro F1 jumps from 0.4366 to 0.4737; Accuracy jumps from 77.51% to 90.00%).
6_optimizer_state_reset.operational_impact: Prevents stale momentum from causing gradient divergence in linear surrogate after abrupt distribution shift.

7_threshold_calibration.mechanism: Shifts inference decision threshold from default 0.50 (argmax) to 0.35.
7_threshold_calibration.isolated_delta_macro_f1: +0.0301 (Macro F1 rises from 0.6279 to 0.6580; Minority Recall rises from 14.29% to 62.45%).
7_threshold_calibration.operational_impact: Compensates for 90:10 class imbalance by lowering decision threshold; trades slight precision for major recall gain.
